Subject: SDE2 candidate — Amanda Lopez: proposed pay mix for signoff

Hi team,

Per our catch-up this morning, attaching the draft comp worksheet for Amanda Lopez (SDE2, SWE track). Candidate has a strong backend + infra background and prefers earlier equity vesting over a larger sign-on. We need a final signoff from compensation and hiring manager to hit candidate's deadline (she wants an answer by EOD Aug 26).

Summary (proposed):
- Base: $160,000 annual
- Annual target bonus: 12% (uncapped)
- Sign-on: $10,000 (one-time)
- RSUs: $120,000 grant, 4-year vesting; 25% cliff / quarterly thereafter (we discussed accelerating to 18 months cliff for retention)
- Start date: target Oct 4, 2026
- Onboarding stipend: $1,500 (relocation optional)

Attachments: SDE2_AmandaLopez_OfferDraft.pdf, comp_workbook_4221.xlsx

Questions for signoff:
1) Approve base/bonus/RWU mix as proposed?
2) If we reduce sign-on to $5k and increase RSUs by $15k, is that acceptable to hiring team and comp?
3) Confirm cost center/headcount: 4221 (platform infra) is reserved for Q4.

If we can get approvals within 48 hours I will finalize the offer and prepare the DocuSign packet.

Thanks,

--

Marissa — thanks for the clear summary and timeline. I spoke with the tech lead; the candidate's profile is right for the role. Two small asks before I sign off:

- Reduce sign-on to $5k and reallocate $10k into RSUs (so total RSUs become $130k). Candidate cares more about equity liquidity long-term.
- Accelerate vesting schedule so that 50% vests in the first 18 months (we can structure 25% at 6 months + monthly thereafter) to improve retention on this hire.

If comp/legal are OK with the accelerated schedule, I approve the base and bonus as proposed. Please confirm the revised numbers in the workbook and loop Karthik for budget headcount confirmation.

Rachel

Thanks — reviewed the revised worksheet (comp_workbook_4221.xlsx). Budget/Headcount and comp band checks:

- Cost center 4221 has headcount reserved for Q4 (confirmed with finance).
- Base $160k and 12% target bonus sits comfortably within our L4 comp band for the platform org.
- Sign-on $5k + RSUs $130k total is acceptable.
- Accelerated vesting (50% in 18 months via a 25% 6-month vest + monthly thereafter) is an exception to standard 1-year cliff. Approving as a limited exception for Amanda; please include this as a note in the offer packet and get legal's quick review.

Amanda — great talking earlier. Attaching the official offer packet; below is the summary. Please review and sign the DocuSign by Wednesday, Aug 26 to secure the slot. If you need more time, let me know and we'll accommodate.

Offer summary (final):
- Title: Software Engineer II (SDE2) — Platform
- Base salary: $160,000/year
- Annual target bonus: 12% of base (paid annually, subject to company performance)
- Sign-on: $5,000 (one-time)
- RSU grant: $130,000 total; 4-year schedule with accelerated early vesting (25% at 6 months, remaining quarterly thereafter equating to ~50% in 18 months).
- Start date: Oct 4, 2026 (flexible)
- Onboarding stipend: $1,500
- Condition: offer contingent on background check and standard employment verification

Attachments: SDE2_AmandaLopez_OfferDraft.pdf (includes DocuSign link), comp_workbook_4221.xlsx

Next steps:
1) Review the packet and sign through DocuSign (link in the PDF).
2) If you want changes to start date or relocation assistance, reply to this thread.

Welcome — were excited about the possibility of you joining the Platform team at Redwood.

Best,
